fact: The column says 18 AI projects are identified among the 138 projects programmed in the 2025-2026 digital transformation programme.

Assabah News reports that Tunisia's National Business Registry launched two AI services on 5 November 2026: Nawarni, a chatbot guiding founders through company creation, and a bot to check and reserve trade names, built with HiiL and funded by the Netherlands embassy.
